decisions.reason: The single-tube air cooled condenser still shares resources with the core business, so it is cheap to hold, but the withdrawal of the related single-tube air fin cooler raises the chance that this line gets consolidated.

This second single-tube condenser overlaps with Product B and is the most likely candidate for merging after Product A was dropped, but there is not yet clear evidence that its value will not be realized.
The tube liner is a low-cost repair add-on that supports the growing lifecycle service strategy, so the option remains cheap to hold with continued upside.
The customized air cooler line with several models fits the firm's core strategy of integrated custom solutions and offers many paths for further investment.
The tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair business at minimal holding cost, so keeping them preserves the option while demand becomes clearer.
